q1_issues.issue: "decides on a new roof" is a PP naming what the activity is directed at — the instruction set's own "work on the mural" / "depend on the pump" case, which it says is "neither Theme nor Patient" and which takes the preposition-named oblique — so Theme is the wrong head here.

q2_gaps: no test distinguishing a particle verb that fuses into one verb_particle symbol (switch_on, bring_in) from a prepositional verb whose PP stays a preposition-named oblique (work on, depend on); "decide on" sits on that boundary with nothing in the instruction set to decide it
notes: The rest checks out: a singular collective noun takes a plain event with no GroupOf and no distribution rule, "new roof" correctly stays two atoms as incidental description rather than fusing, and the bare simple present correctly gets no status atom.
